title: Complete conversation state-machine evidence
requirements: Add the BOT-010 test evidence that its self-review claimed but the actual tests do not contain. Do not change production code.

Use exact pytest.raises(GatewayError), assert the expected code, and avoid broad Exception assertions. Cover stable accepted replay metadata while proving public as_dict still excludes internal receipt/inquiry IDs.
Cover BEGINNER, EXPERIENCED and omitted UNKNOWN experience without any admission/gallop gate or hidden draft field. Cover optional self-reported contact and omitted contact separately.

Cover every out-of-order mutating action, RESET without a draft, required/extra/malformed action fields, and verify zero mutations on every rejection plus exactly one mutation on each accepted mutating action.

Prove inactive or missing service option rejection at initial selection, resumed draft and SUBMIT after catalog change. Prove the exact original GatewayError object propagates for VERSION_CONFLICT, IDEMPOTENCY_MISMATCH, RESULT_EXPIRED and CATALOG_UNAVAILABLE across relevant gateway operations.
Keep the recording fake deterministic and platform-neutral; add no PostgreSQL, SDK, transport, routes, copy, credentials or production changes.
acceptance: Focused tests directly prove replay privacy, experience neutrality, strict transitions, inactive option checks, exact mutation counts and identity-preserving gateway errors.
The actual diff changes only focused tests and the tracked BOT-011 contract.
Focused conversation tests, scope and whitespace checks pass.

shared_paths_approval.reason: Test-only completion of falsely claimed BOT-010 state-machine evidence before publication.
